images.name: hero
images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Photorealistic editorial illustration for a B2B blog about colored glassware purchasing, physical sample comparison and repeat orders. Landscape 3:2 composition, target 1536 by 1024 pixels. Quiet premium commercial photography, natural glass transparency, realistic refraction, softly defined rims, physically plausible connected handles and bases, restrained warm-white, muted amber and pale sage-green palette. Unbranded generic conceptual vessels, not an exact catalog model. No people, no hands, no labels, no typography, no logos, no watermark, no certification symbols, no measuring equipment or pass/fail marks. No collage, no split panels. Asset type: blog cover. On a warm ivory stone tabletop against an ivory studio wall, arrange one elegant translucent amber glass water pitcher with a simple loop handle and pouring spout, one pale sage-green glass water pitcher of a different understated silhouette, and three short plain cylindrical tumblers in amber, green and clear glass. Five vessels total, all empty, separate silhouettes with breathing room, no overlaps obscuring rims. Front three-quarter view, whole products visible, moderate depth of field so every vessel is legible. Soft window daylight with attractive gentle colored shadows, subtle stone texture, no dramatic hard sunlight. Refined asymmetrical still-life composition with generous space around the glassware, suitable for responsive center cropping. Emphasis on comparing a color collection, no additional props.

images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Photorealistic editorial illustration for a B2B blog about colored glassware purchasing, physical sample comparison and repeat orders. Landscape 3:2 composition, target 1536 by 1024 pixels. Quiet premium commercial photography, natural glass transparency, realistic refraction, softly defined rims, physically plausible connected handles and bases, restrained warm-white, muted amber and pale sage-green palette. Asset type: body photograph illustrating a proposed mixed-color glassware packing arrangement. Close overhead three-quarter view of an open plain natural kraft corrugated carton on a warm off-white packing table. Exactly four identical-size empty cylindrical drinking tumblers, two translucent amber and two translucent pale sage-green, arranged in a clean 2 by 2 grid. Matte kraft texture, soft diffuse light, no tape obscuring the glasses, no labels or printed symbols, no extra products outside the box.
